messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.
Flatey býður upp á kyrrð og ró, fallega fjallasýn á Flateyjarskaga, víðáttu og ilm af hafinu. Þar er alltaf gott veður. Færir mann aftur til fortíðar þar sem þurfti að hafa aðeins meira fyrir lífinu.

message.content: Flatey offers quiet and peace, beautiful mountain views on the Flateyjarskagi, wide horizons and the scent of the sea. The weather is always good there. Returning there takes one back to the past, where one might need only a little more for life.
